title: Refinement of a colostrum-deprived pig model for infectious disease research
author: Opriessnig, Gerber, et al.

steps.title: Clean and disinfect facility
steps.instruction: Wash rooms, walls, and equipment with 70 °C water using a high‑pressure (180 psi) nozzle, spray with PRL‑Grease Free degreaser, let it remain on surfaces for 10–15 min, then fumigate with Virkon S at the manufacturer’s recommended concentration; allow the area to dry completely for 1–2 days.

substeps.instruction: Clean all surfaces with 70 °C water and a 180 psi high‑pressure nozzle.
Spray PRL‑Grease Free degreaser on surfaces and keep for at least 10–15 min.
Fumigate the room and equipment with Virkon S at the recommended concentration.
Leave the room to dry completely for 1–2 days before use.

steps.title: Assemble elevated pen compartments
steps.instruction: Install elevated plastic tubs divided into four quarters, each quarter capable of housing 1–2 piglets; equip each compartment with a self‑feeder, nipple drinker, slatted plastic floor, and a drain system for waste removal.

steps.title: Prepare selected pregnant dams
steps.instruction: Choose several pregnant sows close to farrowing that are housed individually in farrowing crates on a nearby commercial farm; clean each dam’s vulva with a povidone scrub, place a clean cotton towel beneath the vulva and replace if soiled, and continuously monitor to prevent newborn piglets from contacting the floor or dam, using multiple personnel when possible.

substeps.instruction: Select pregnant dams near farrowing and house them individually in farrowing crates.
Clean the vulva of each dam with a povidone scrub.
Place a clean cotton towel below the vulva; replace the towel if it becomes contaminated or saturated.
Monitor the dam closely to avoid any contact between newborn piglets and the floor or the dam; employ multiple people for assistance.

steps.title: Transfer newborn piglets to tote
steps.instruction: Immediately after farrowing, move the newborn piglets into a transport tote positioned beside the dam’s crate and keep the tote under a heating lamp to maintain appropriate temperature.
